timestamp: seconds; use actual nonuniform timestamps. Constant phase spacing gives higher temporal sampling at faster motion rates.
joint_angles: signed geometric radians relative to CAD neutral; not PWM/electrical zero
body_pose: translation mm plus XYZ Euler radians, rotated around body_rotation_pivot_mm from configuration
foot_targets: sole_reference_world is the moving rigid-foot reference; lowest_contact_world is actual geometric support; neither is an attachment bolt
contact_model: Fixed world XY sole-reference during stance; actual complete sole hull minimum Z is enforced. Contact migrates on the faceted rocking sole; material-point slip is reported separately.
phase: unwrapped continuous gait phase; demonstration smoothly changes stride and rate. Future stance travel sets touchdown anchors; current stance anchors stay fixed.
control_policy: p=stride_percent/100; stance_sweep=92*p mm; cycle_advance=stance_sweep/0.7; cycle_frequency=motion_rate/1.8 Hz; speed=cycle_advance*cycle_frequency. Rear bias=(30/92)*predicted body travel during each stance; only future footholds move when stride changes.
mass_and_COM: COM assumed, unknown mass and payload; no physical qualification
rearward_bias: 30/92 of anticipated body travel over each stance. Nominal columns describe current controls; actual per-leg anchors anticipate the upcoming stance during transitions.
runtime_scope: Offline deterministic planned demo. A real-time command/replanning loop and embedded IK implementation are still required.
